mapper.select: INSERT INTO backfill_run (from_year, to_year, snapshot_date, files_total, state) VALUES (#{fromYear}, #{toYear}, #{snapshotDate}, #{filesTotal}, 'RUNNING') RETURNING id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO backfill_file (run_id, idx, url) VALUES (#{runId}, #{idx}, #{url})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM backfill_run WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM backfill_file WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND idx = #{idx}
SELECT * FROM backfill_file WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY idx
mapper.update: UPDATE backfill_file SET works_created = COALESCE(works_created, 0) + #{n} WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND idx = #{idx} AND done_at IS NULL
UPDATE backfill_file SET records_read = #{read}, records_kept = #{kept}, works_created = COALESCE(works_created, 0), done_at = now() WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND idx = #{idx} AND done_at IS NULL
UPDATE backfill_run SET state = 'DONE', finished = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'RUNNING' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM backfill_file f WHERE f.run_id = #{id} AND f.done_at IS NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.from_year AS fromYear, r.to_year AS toYear, r.snapshot_date AS snapshotDate, r.files_total AS filesTotal, r.state, count(f.done_at) AS filesDone, COALESCE(sum(f.records_read), 0) AS recordsRead, COALESCE(sum(f.records_kept), 0) AS recordsKept, COALESCE(sum(f.works_created), 0) AS worksCreated FROM (SELECT * FROM backfill_run ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}) r LEFT JOIN backfill_file f ON f.run_id = r.id GROUP BY r.id, r.from_year, r.to_year, r.snapshot_date, r.files_total, r.state ORDER BY r.id DESC
